description: Curated demergers of NSE-listed Indian companies (2023 onwards) used by scripts/holdings_review.py to flag holdings bought before a record date. ratio = new shares of the resulting company per parent shares held on the record date. cost_split_pct = the parent's published apportionment of the pre-demerger cost of acquisition (null when not verified). Each entry carries its sources and the date it was checked. Add entries only from the company's or the exchange's own announcement; never estimate numbers. Optional fields used by scripts/stock_analysis.py: ex_date (first session without the entitlement, when it differs from the record date), appointed_date and effective_date (from the scheme; statements change from the appointed date), resulting_first_full_fy_end (the resulting company's first financial year that contains the whole business; before it, annual growth and the P/E history are withheld), and resulting_companies (one entry per company when a demerger created several; cost_split_pct.resulting is then their total).
